spreadTheWordlist.notes: Constructor-scored English wordlist by Brooke Husic and collaborators. Score floor 50 applied at corpus build. Attribution required; non-commercial use only; derived corpus JSON inherits the license.

usaTodayArchive.dataset: USA Today daily crosswords, 1995-2026, xd format (8,867 files)
usaTodayArchive.notes: sha256 is over the sorted list of per-file sha256s. All 15x15. 21 files rejected at parse (incomplete grids or duplicate answers). Raw archive is re-downloaded on demand (repo/crosswords/data.txt keeps the URL); editions in repo/crosswords/challenges carry solution and clues only, and the replay formula maps each date back to its archive original.

eldiarioDaily.dataset: eldiario.es daily Spanish crossword, 13x13, one puzzle per day
eldiarioDaily.notes: The publish-dailies workflow runs scripts/crosswords/archive-spanish.ts once per day and merges puzzles.es (solution and clues only) into the matching repo/crosswords/challenges edition. The feed serves only its latest puzzle, so a day missed by the workflow stays missing.
